items.question: Which six epithets or powers extend the ongoing enumeration of divine manifestations?
premises: The sequence continues a list of feminine nominative forms.
Each term functions as a name or qualifying epithet.
The six terms are āgatā, nirgatā, vajrā, suhitā, sahitā, and akṣatā.
items.inference: These six terms are included as additional members in the enumerated series of divine manifestations or epithets.
uncertainties: Whether each term is a proper name or a descriptive epithet is not fully determined from the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Arrived, departed, thunderbolt, well-disposed, accompanied, and unbroken.
